_comment: Positions are the gripper TCP in the world frame, mm. Record destinations with: python record_pose.py <name>

overview._comment: overview-cam calibration grid (world mm) and fingertip heights above the table; see overview.py
overview._grid: where the overview-cam sees the claws whole (it sits on the -y side looking toward +y; at y<=0 the claws leave the frame)

grasp._clearance: closed fingertips this far above the table at the end of the grasp (a flat nut is ~5 mm thick)
grasp._tcp_to_tip: how far the CLOSED fingertips reach past the gripper TCP (arm + 150 mm): motion_probe.py --live --touch 400,0 --closed on the bare table, 2026-11-13. Open they reach ~13 mm: the linkage carries the tips ~7-10 mm down as the fingers close, so the grasp is planned for the closed tips and the open fingers descend well clear of the table
grasp._table_z: world z of the table top; the median of every scan except one (+1.5) on 2026-11-13
grasp._empty_below_pos: finger position (0-850) under which the gripper closed on nothing; a held screw stopped at ~700
